Elena: FYI scheduling a scoped infra apply tonight 01:00 UTC for release/2024.06. Changes: cross-account IAM role for analytics, route propagation fix, and mandatory resource tag enforcement (tagging policy).
Elena: Change window 01:00-02:00 UTC. Need an apply owner + someone to write the release notes blurb.
Omar: I can run the apply and own rollbacks. Priya: I'll draft the release note blurb and watch metrics.
infra-bot: Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/infra/2024-06-apply 1 1 Steps for rollback and state snapshot included.
deploybot: preflight: terraform fmt OK, plan OK for targeted modules. Provider pin: aws v4.82.0 (lock sha: ghi789).
Omar: Plan command (from infra/networks):
```
terraform workspace select prod || terraform workspace new prod
terraform init -reconfigure -backend-config=prod.backend
terraform plan -out=plan.network -var-file=prod.tfvars
```
Priya: Staggered apply: region-primary (us-east-1) -> canary services -> region-secondary (ap-southeast-1). Wait 7 minutes between regions. No auto-approve for secondary.
Elena: Rollback triggers: deploybot apply failure, >8 error 5xx/min for 5m on core-gateway, or S3 read errors > 15/min. Manual rollback if p95 latency increases by +150ms for 10m.
Omar: Will take a state backup to s3://infra-backups/release-2024-06/$(date +%s).tfstate before apply. Also locking note: ensure no automation is holding locks (CI runs).
